text: A muscular male figure with blond hair, short and wavy, runs forward. His face is oval, expression focused. He wears a brown belt with gold buckle, dark shorts, and red armbands. A golden medallion hangs from his neck. His skin tone is light tan. He holds a dagger in his right hand. Behind him looms a large, shadowy humanoid figure draped in blue fabric. Ruined stone structures and water are visible in the background under a pinkish-purple sky.
